title: Upgrade Amounts and Component Substitution Charges Across the Package Range
content:
Upgrades within a package, and the substitution of one component of an itinerary for another, are priced at the amounts recorded against the product booked. Every product in Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products carries its own figures, and a product that permits no upgrade records none.

| Product | Upgrades permitted after booking | Room upgrade per night | Cabin grade upgrade for the whole sailing | Cabin upgrade on the package flight, per traveller | Substituting one component for another |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | no | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 299.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | yes | 40.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 279.00 USD | 50.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | yes | 55.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 349.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | yes | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 399.00 USD | 95.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | yes | 0.00 USD | 449.00 USD | 449.00 USD | 125.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | yes | 95.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Reading the room and cabin columns

The room upgrade amount is a nightly figure and the cabin grade upgrade is a single figure for the whole sailing; a product records one or the other according to the kind of accommodation it sells, and a figure of 0.00 USD records that the product carries no amount under that heading. On the Luxury Collection Package the flight upgrade and the component substitution charge are both recorded as 0.00 USD.

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

A room upgrade taken on a seven-night package booked under the All-Inclusive Resort Package is read at 55.00 USD for each of the seven nights, being 385.00 USD in all. A cabin grade upgrade on the Ocean Cruise Package is read once at 449.00 USD however many nights the sailing runs.
